Clear exposition with excellent proof sketch (Section 5.1.1) that provides strong intuition before technical details

Careful handling of NCF gradient flow that can become unbounded at finite time using unbounded Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz inequality
Honest discussion of limitations and open challenges, particularly regarding ReLU networks
Detailed and apparently correct proofs with comprehensive appendices
Experimental validation showing phenomenon occurs even when theory doesn't apply

Well-structured presentation with clear proof sketch (Section 5.1.1) providing good intuition; honest treatment of limitations

Complete characterization of rank-one KKT points (Theorems 3-4) with both sufficient and necessary conditions (under stated assumptions)
Clear organization with helpful proof sketches in main text and comprehensive appendices
weaknesses: CRITICAL: Locally Lipschitz gradient assumption excludes ReLU networks entirely—the most common activation function in practice. Appendix D dismisses this briefly without rigorous justification for why Clarke subdifferential analysis is intractable

Largely incremental over Kumar & Haupt (2024)—main innovation (time rescaling) is relatively straightforward once L-dependence is identified

Extra assumptions in Theorems 3-4 (non-negativity of entries) are only validated empirically on 30 synthetic instances, lacking theoretical justification
